finding: The registered V7 ranking workflow explicitly requires report.survivorship_safe to be false, yet still accepts and publishes frozen-holdout ranking metrics when the implementation is present. A known survivorship-unsafe sample therefore satisfies the workflow contract instead of failing closed.
why_material: Frozen chronological timing alone does not remove survivorship bias from market-universe selection.
If resolved/disappeared markets are absent from the evaluation universe, rank IC and top-bottom spreads can be biased even without look-ahead inside the fitted model.
The workflow can therefore turn a known causal-data defect into apparently valid forward evidence once the ranking implementation is re-anchored to main.
required_successor_contract: Build or consume a point-in-time universe snapshot whose membership was knowable at each decision timestamp.
Set survivorship_safe=true only after that provenance is actually verified; missing provenance fails closed.
Require survivorship_safe=true in the registered frozen-holdout workflow before publishing or crediting ranking metrics.
Keep frozen 2h and 6h fits immutable after holdout_start minus embargo and keep relative-pair-only semantics.
Do not mix adaptive walk-forward evidence with frozen-holdout inference.
